summary: A Yes vote authorizes Perris Union High School District to issue $187 million in bonds for school facilities, repaid by a property tax estimated at $20 per $100,000 of assessed value.

tax.text: The campaign supports extending the existing property-tax rate to finance school improvements.
tax.quote: Measure AA would simply extend the current rate previously approved by voters at $20 per $100,000 of a property’s assessed (not market) value annually for so long as bonds are outstanding.

schools.text: The campaign supports locally controlled funding for facilities and instruction throughout Perris Union High School District.
schools.quote: Funds would be locally controlled and would benefit all local PUHSD schools.

tax.text: The No position rejects $187 million in bonds backed by a $20 levy per $100,000 of assessed value while the bonds remain outstanding.
tax.quote: authorizing $187,000,000 in bonds at legal rates, levying $20 per $100,000 assessed value (averaging $12 million annually) while bonds are outstanding
